On subsequent loads `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` would reject, breaking token refresh. Mechanism fully verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the result of `schema.safeParse(response)` which is a `{success, data, error}` wrapper object. In CalendarService.ts line 97, `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` assigns this wrapper, then `data: { key }` persists the wrapper object instead of `key.data`. The next time the credential is loaded, `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` will fail because the stored object has `{success, data, error}` structure instead of the actual token fields. This is a real bug.
